name: Aminata Diallo
action: Aminata stays quiet for a moment, looking down, then says in a low voice, "I can help some, but I can’t spend the whole day there. I have to study for Monday."
reason: Aminata’s initial tendency was to stay quiet, absorb the request, and avoid an immediate refusal while protecting her study time. Reflection strengthened that hesitation by making the family request feel more dangerous to accept without limits, while also bringing into view her habit of showing up for kin and her reluctance to shame Fatoumata with a flat no. Because she is exhausted, behind on difficult exam work, and protective of the savings that support her sister’s future, she does not give an unqualified yes. The revised action tendency therefore leads her to pause instead of answering quickly and to offer only limited help, with a careful explanation that she must keep some time for study.
